title: ai chat: render a blueprint proposal with decision iterate_or_new as the extend-or-new question, not as a 开始搭建 approval card
body:
Filing gate ②: the ui half of a gap measured on cloud#3368 (GA readiness, Sam 「同意立卡」 2026-10-29 09:46Z). Findings: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3368#issuecomment-6493627066. The cloud half is objectstack-ai/cloud#3369. Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

AI 搭建时，如果新方案和已有应用重叠，cloud 的 propose_blueprint 会返回 `decision: 'iterate_or_new'`，意思是要先问用户「在已有应用上扩展，还是另建」。但聊天界面把它渲染成普通的「开始搭建」批准卡片，用户一点就可能另建一个重复应用。cloud#3369 让服务端不再把它当作可批准的方案。这张卡让界面把它显示成那个问题本身。

## Facts

- objectstack `ui/**` has no reference to `iterate_or_new` (grep at main). `mapMessages` renders every `blueprint_proposed` result as a normal approval card.
- The result carries `existingAppOverlap` (the app's `name` and `label`, what it contains, and which planned objects duplicate it). See cloud `service-ai-studio/src/tools/blueprint-tools.ts:2136-2138`.

## Work

1. When a `blueprint_proposed` result has `decision: 'iterate_or_new'`, render no 开始搭建 approval button. Show the question naming the existing app, with two choices («在「X」上继续完善» / «另建一个独立应用») that send the matching reply.
2. Tests: an iterate_or_new result renders the question and no approve button; a plain proposal is unchanged. Include an ablation.

## Done when

No approve button is shown for an iterate_or_new proposal.
